name: Ashoka Aptitude Assessment
full_name: Ashoka Aptitude Assessment (AAA, often called AAT) + On-the-Spot Essay
mode: Online, remote-proctored (laptop/desktop); some rounds have used physical centres

cycle_2026.application_window: Opened 13 Oct 2025; 4 rounds: R1 by 26 Nov 2025, R2 by 21 Jan 2026, R3 by 22 Apr 2026, R4 by 31 May 2026
cycle_2026.fee: Application fee: not published on the pages we could read

cycle_2027: Announced: applications for the 2027 intake opened 7 Oct 2026. R1 apply by 23 Nov 2026, test 6 Dec 2026, decision 3 Feb 2027; R2 apply by 20 Jan 2027, test 31 Jan 2027, decision 14 Apr 2027; R3 apply by 14 Apr 2027, test 25 Apr 2027, decision 7 Jun 2027; R4 apply by 23 May 2027, test 30 May 2027, decision 30 Jun 2027 (dates via news reports of the official schedule)
eligibility: Class XII passed/appearing from a recognised board. Ashoka does not publish a fixed minimum % officially; Careers360 reports 50%. Apply in only one round per cycle.

sections.name: Problem Solving
sections.notes: Numerical and spatial reasoning, DI/LR-heavy (based on the Cambridge Thinking Skills Assessment style)

sections.name: Critical Thinking
sections.notes: Argument analysis: strengthen/weaken, assumption, main idea, short RC

sections.name: On-the-Spot Essay (OSE)
sections.notes: Pick 1 of 2 topics; minimum 250 words; typed, no copy-paste or Grammarly

pattern.notes: MCQs from both sections come in mixed order. Mandatory for all applicants, even with SAT/ACT.

selection_process: Online application (Class X–XII marks, personal essays, activities, optional recommendation) → Aptitude Assessment + On-the-Spot Essay → interview for shortlisted students → decision (offer / waitlist / deferral / deny). Holistic review; no weightages published.
verbal_weight: High: 20 of 40 MCQs are Critical Thinking (verbal reasoning/RC) plus a mandatory timed essay and written application essays

colleges.name: Ashoka University
programmes: BA/BSc (Hons) 3-yr + optional 4th year — majors incl. Economics, Economics & Finance, PPE, Psychology, English, History, Politics, Sociology, CS, Maths etc.
colleges.fees: 2026-27: ₹10.74 L tuition + ₹2.11 L residence + ₹5,400 services = ₹12.90 L first year; 2027-28 reported as ₹13.55 L first year. Meals extra. Need-based aid available.

cutoff.note: Ashoka does not publish AAA cut-offs; selection is holistic.

colleges.placements: NIRF 2026 data (2024-25): UG 3-yr — 61 placed, median ₹8.75 L, avg ₹11.6 L, highest ₹35 L

notes: SAT (DI code 7343, superscore accepted) and ACT are optional add-ons — they do NOT replace the Aptitude Assessment. One round per cycle only. Ashoka's own site renders dates via script, so 2027 round dates here come from news reports of the official schedule — verify on apply.ashoka.edu.in.

name: FLAME FEAT

cycle_2026.application_window: 5 cycles: Early Decision by 30 Nov 2025; Cycle I by 4 Jan 2026; II by 1 Feb 2026; III by 29 Mar 2026; IV by 3 May 2026
cycle_2026.exam_date: ED: 28 Nov–2 Dec 2025; I: 2–6 Jan 2026; II: 31 Jan–4 Feb 2026; III: 28 Mar–1 Apr 2026; IV: 2–6 May 2026 (early slot 20–23 Apr)
cycle_2026.result: ED: 6 Jan 2026; I: 5 Feb; II: 9 Mar; III: 28 Apr; IV: 4 Jun 2026

cycle_2027: Announced (official): Early Decision apply by 29 Nov 2026, FEAT 4–6 Dec 2026, PI 11–13 Dec, result 12 Jan 2027; Cycle I by 3 Jan 2027 (FEAT 8–10 Jan, result 10 Feb); Cycle II by 1 Feb 2027 (FEAT 5–7 Feb, result 16 Mar); Cycle III by 28 Mar 2027 (FEAT 2–4 Apr, result 4 May); Cycle IV by 2 May 2027 (FEAT 4–7 May, result 9 Jun; early FEAT 16–18 Apr → result 25 May)
eligibility: Class XII (any board) passed/appearing; marks sheet by 30 Sep 2027. Age under 21 on 31 Jul 2027. Maths at XII needed for CS, Applied Maths, Data Science & Economics; preferred for Economics. No minimum % stated.

pattern.marking: Total 140 marks; no negative marking; no calculator
pattern.notes: Plus an online on-the-spot essay (200–250 words, 20 min) and an online personal interview.

selection_process: Application + SOP → FEAT (or SAT/ACT/JEE Main Paper 1 score instead) → on-the-spot essay → online personal interview. Holistic 'sliding' evaluation of test, essay, PI, Class X/XII record, extracurriculars and SOP; no weightages published.
verbal_weight: Heavy: 40 of 100 questions (50 of 140 marks) are Verbal Ability, plus essay and SOP

colleges.name: FLAME University
programmes: 4-yr with exit after 3 yrs; majors incl. Economics, Finance, Psychology, Public Policy, Data Science & Economics
colleges.fees: Class of 2027: Yr 1 tuition ₹9.15 L + residential ₹1.95 L (rises to ₹10.5 L + ₹2.1 L by Yr 4)

cutoff.note: FLAME FAQ says it does not publish a cutoff; no guaranteed FEAT/SAT score.

notes: SAT (code 6784), ACT (code 8974) or JEE Main Paper 1 can replace FEAT — those applicants do only the essay + interview. CUET is not listed as an accepted route. Early Decision is binding-style early round.

name: Krea KAT

cycle_2026.application_window: Rolling rounds Oct 2025–Jun 2026 (R1 deadline 4 Jan 2026; R4 deadline 12 Jun 2026)

eligibility: Class XII (any stream) passed/appearing from a recognised board. Integrated MBA has stricter rules (see college entry).

verbal_weight: Significant: one of four sections is Critical Thinking & Verbal Ability and another is Writing Skills
